headwords: thằng chột làm vua xứ mù

flags.why: This usage refers to gay people or, more broadly, the LGBT community, rather than specifically to non-binary people ([source](https://baotintuc.vn/xa-hoi/trong-the-gioi-trai-goi-chinh-sach-nao-cho-nguoi-dong-tinh-20130724004424655.htm)).

This names rhythmic gymnastics, whose apparatus includes hoops, balls, clubs and ribbons, rather than artistic gymnastics ([source](https://tdtt.gov.vn/Portals/0/EasyDNNNewsDocuments/77216/QUYET%20DINH%20chuan%2025.8.2022%20BAN%20HANH%20DIEU%20LE%20KHUNG_2.pdf)).

The example says she trains in rhythmic gymnastics, not artistic gymnastics ([source](https://tdtt.gov.vn/Portals/0/EasyDNNNewsDocuments/77216/QUYET%20DINH%20chuan%2025.8.2022%20BAN%20HANH%20DIEU%20LE%20KHUNG_2.pdf)).
flags.fix: She has trained in rhythmic gymnastics since she was eight.
